Make the labels larger and move the number line to the top-left or off-centre. Add a title at the top centre in light cyan instead of the small left-aligned 'WORKED EXAMPLE' tag. Also fill some of the empty space, for example with a caption or formula beside the line.

Place the number line off-centre or top-left with a larger label font. Add a brace for the +1 step. Space the points proportionally to the values, so 101 sits much closer to 100 than 102.01. Add a short caption beside or beneath the line.

Mostly good. To match the palette/layout, move the equation off-centre or top-left and add a label or brace (e.g. 'changes each step') under the highlighted +1.01. Keep the cyan highlight.
